title: Body Donation in HHT
summary: The possibility of body donation in hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT) means that human tissue samples with and without vascular malformations can be analyzed. The aim is to gain insights into the disease mechanism.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* positiv genetic testing for HHT and/ or at least three fulfilled Curacao Criteria
* older than 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* missing inclusion criteria

sites.f: Institut für Anatomie und Klinik für HNO-Heilkunde, Universitätsklinik Essen
